rule.rank: percentile rank = (scores below + half the ties) / population size; the population of an item is every stock holding a score on that item from its registered run (or its published memo)
rule.registered_run: the newest live card in the conveyor's trays whose run holds scores; dry, cancelled and control runs never enter
rule.boundaries: per item, the lowest score that earned each grade today; null where no score earned that grade
rule.comparison_set: the stocks analysed by the new approach (the Sets of Questions/Items approach)
rule.fixed_letters: on memo topics 5, 6, 8, 11 and 12 a cell carrying fixed_letter shows the Rater's own letter from a real-world measure (A to F, no sub-grade), never re-cut; its rank and p are information only (D-SQ-267, D-SQ-271)
rule.fixed_cutoffs: v1.5 (his Messages 427 and 428; D-SQ-280): three letter rules, one per item, stated in each item's letter_rule. The Rater's letter from his cut-offs on the MEASURE for topics 6, 8, 11 and 12, the number placed inside the letter's band. Rank and the percentile stay on every cell for information.
rule.scales: v1.5: every cell carries scale_tag; a rank letter is cut only among cells of the same scale (rater-v3 = the Rater v3.0 after the memo; rater-v2 and rater-v1-keyed = earlier Raters; writer-1.9 = the Investment Analyst's own score as it wrote the answer, the old method; writer-memo = the memo Analyst's own topic score).
